status: Engineering candidate from the 15 November 2026 evening run (EST). Not released for manufacture.
source_bodies: ../guides_v2/M5_lane_anchorB.stl and ../guides_v2/M6_lane_anchorC.stl (V2 lanes A/B/C 21/24/28 mm, unchanged guides/stations)
feature: Axisymmetric convex fillet (bellmouth) on each inboard lane-hole exit of the rigid end regions; return holes, outer interface faces, backbone bores, joints and guides are unchanged.
assumptions: Rope centreline bend radius = wall radius + 1 mm. No rope D/d rating is available for the uncalibrated PA6 surrogate rope; the 5-8 mm centreline radii are geometric choices, not a qualified bend limit.
